mapper.select: SELECT b.no, b.writer_no, b.category, b.title, b.content, b.view_count, b.created_date, b.modified_date, m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no ORDER BY b.no DESC

SELECT b.no, b.writer_no, b.category, b.title, b.content, b.view_count, b.created_date, b.modified_date, m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no WHERE b.no = #{no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board ( writer_no, category, title, content ) VALUES ( #{writerNo}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT b.no, b.writer_no, b.category, b.title, b.content, b.view_count, b.created_date, b.modified_date, m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no WHERE b.category = #{category} ORDER BY b.no DESC

SELECT b.no, b.writer_no, b.category, b.title, b.content, b.view_count, b.created_date, b.modified_date, m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no WHERE b.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.nickname LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY b.no DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn, board_data.* FROM ( SELECT b.no, b.writer_no, b.category, b.title, b.content, b.view_count, b.created_date, b.modified_date, m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no ORDER BY b.no DESC ) board_data WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rn >= #{startRow}
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET category = #{category}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, modified_date = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE no = #{no}
